about: Hand verbs for plan 0.2 (docs/PLAN.md). A verb is a short clip of the palm frame relative to a grip frame, plus finger shapes. blender/build_hands.py bakes every verb x grasp x side into hands.glb as an action named <verb>[_<grasp>].<L|R>; the web player (web/src/operate/motions.ts) reads this file for the same numbers.

frames.grip: On the asset: origin at the contact point, +Z out of the surface toward the hand, +X the direction the fingers run along the surface.
frames.palm: On the hand: origin on the palm skin over the middle metacarpal, +X toward the middle fingertip, +Z out of the palm. hands.json gives it relative to each wrist bone. The palm pads stand about 8 mm proud of it, hence the flat grasp's pad.
frames.shapes: Curl angles (deg, about each bone's X; + bends toward the palm) for the three bones of fingers 2-5 and the thumb; MakeHuman's rest hand is already curled, so a flat hand needs negative curls. thumb_spread swings the thumb about its first bone's Z. Angles from a search that puts the fingertips where each grasp needs them (blender/README.md).
frames.contact: Where the palm frame sits at contact: grip frame, turned rot_z_deg about +Z, flipped so palm +Z points into the surface, then lifted standoff_mm along grip +Z. A key's `palm` is a further offset in the contact frame (mm, then degrees XYZ).
frames.approach: A grasp's optional approach direction (contact frame, unit): a verb key's palm Z offset (how far off the surface the hand is) moves the palm along it instead of along +Z. Fingertip grasps come in from above, back along the fingers, rather than straight out of a vertical face.
frames.index_tip: standoff "index_tip": instead of the palm, the index fingertip pad of the grasp's shape (hands.json pads) sits on the contact point, so a fingertip grasp touches with the fingertip and keeps the palm clear.

stagger_s.about: Fingers do not move together: each finger's keys are delayed by this much (thumb to little), the index leading, as in reach-to-grasp recordings.

slide.about: Push the part along the grip's +X (the fingers' direction) by 5 mm; the plan moves the part the same 5 mm. The palm is anchored where the verb starts, not on the moving part.

rotate.about: Hold the crank knob while the handle turns; the player moves the knob, the hand rides it (attach: position).

measure.about: Fingertip check: press the parallel and feel for movement.
